thread:
Ari W: QBR ask dropped in from Sales. They want a 4-slide "cost posture" appendix for three onboarding customers (LatticeX, HarborAI, Finchly). Low friction: burn trend, 14/30d forecast, immediate mitigations + a one-line exec ask. Who takes which?
Noel P: I can take LatticeX. Will check 7/30/90d token burn and per-route medians.
Samira H: I'll own HarborAI. I'll focus on embed rebuilds and function-call hotspots.
Evan G: Finchly for me. I'll run a QPS x seq sensitivity and a rough quantization ROI calc. ETA Tue EOD.
Ari W: New twist: Finance wants a "credit risk" column. Rule suggestion: mark "at-risk" if projected runout < 35 days OR 14d burn increase >20%. If at-risk, recommend either (A) throttle + enable cache or (B) one-time buffer.
Noel P: For LatticeX, dev-team is running long-context debug calls. Propose dev-route cap 800 tokens and add a sampling layer.
Samira H: HarborAI has a nightly full-embed rebuild. Roughly 48% of weekly spend. Recommend incremental rebuild + shard scheduling.
Evan G: Using our local estimator:
```
python infra/cost_est.py --acct FINCHLY --horizon 30 --qps 25,50,100 --lens 64,256,1024,2048 --quantize_est
```
Noel P: Can DataOps grant me read to latticex-prod-billing for raw events 90d? Need to confirm dev-originated traffic.
QuotaBot: access granted to noel.p@redwood for project latticex-prod-billing.
Ari W: Also adding a standard pilot credit: Sales approved a $3,750 one-time buffer for onboarding accounts if CS proposes and owns a 14-day optimization plan. Add a slide that says "$3.75k pilot available".
Samira H: I'll include a recommended throttle JSON snippet for nightly jobs and a one-paragraph enablement email. Draft blurb:
"Hi <acct>, we observed a spike driven by full-embed rebuilds. Quick wins: 1) switch to incremental rebuilds 2) cap non-critical context to 1024 3) enable quantized model for batch. We can provide a one-time $3.75k pilot credit if you accept a 14-day optimization run. Reply OK to schedule.
"
Evan G: Sims uploaded: https://drive.redwood/qbr/finchly-sim.csv. Quick headline: 100qps@1024 -> ~$1.6k/day unoptimized; quantization estimate ~32% savings. Also attaching a 3x4 sensitivity CSV.
Noel P: If DataOps gives read I'll pull per-route token medians and flag any route >10% of total tokens.
QuotaBot: access granted to noel.p@redwood for latticex-route-events.
Ari W: Owners recap: LatticeX=Noel, HarborAI=Samira, Finchly=Evan, Enablement=Ari. Deliverables due Tue 4pm PT so I can stitch Thurs morning.
Samira H: One small ask: if an account is "at-risk" and embeds >40% of spend, recommend immediate outreach + automated throttle preset. I'll add that to the playbook.
Evan G: I'll export the QPS x seq matrix as a tiny table for the exec slide.
Noel P: Dry-run Thurs 10am PT works for me.
Ari W: Great — please ping here if you hit access or sim issues. I'll assemble the appendix Wed night and send a preview Thu AM. :sparkles:
